summary.text: Barbara Favola is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia for District 40, serving since 2012. The Senate's member page lists committee assignments including Education and Health (chair), Courts of Justice, and Finance and Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: Barbara A. Favola was born in New London, Connecticut, on June 21, 1955, according to the Senate's member page.

The page says she earned a B.S. from St. Joseph College in 1977 and a master's in public administration from New York University in 1980, and lists her occupations as development consultant in higher education and health policy analyst.
The page lists her as a former Arlington County Board member and chair from 1997 to 2011 and as Senate chair of the Women's Reproductive Health Caucus.
It notes that she chairs the Education and Health Committee and also serves on Courts of Justice, Finance and Appropriations, Rehabilitation and Social Services, and Rules.
